## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues where applicable.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and their results. Explain any checks not run.

## Operations and documentation

Describe configuration, compatibility and update/restore implications, or state
that none apply. Call out changes to Item names, widget/library UIDs, ENV settings,
Compose profiles or persistent data, with migration steps where needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] User-facing changes and migration instructions are documented where needed.
- [ ] Examples, logs and screenshots contain no credentials or private installation data.
